_comment: Two caps for two different things. max_survivor_fraction is a one-sided cap on the SAMPLED run's survivor rate (saturable: below 1.0, because a rate in [0,1] can never exceed 1.0). unpinned_sites is the exact-count ratchet over the DETERMINISTIC inventory -- every candidate site the six operators generate across the whole tree -- and only moves down: a diff that adds a candidate site without a disposition raises it and is refused. A site carries a disposition under survivor_triage (a verdict) or killed_by (a driver that kills it). See the header of tests/mutation_table.py.

custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pum.reason: resolve()'s `raw is None` guard is redundant: _fold(None) is 'none', no alias key folds to 'none', and 'none' is in neither _ALIASES nor _STATUS_AMBIGUOUS, so _ALIASES.get('none') returns None on both paths -- measured on this tree (round-5 D3-07; the probe is tools/audit/round5/D3/equiv_probe.py).

custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/__i.old: if task is not None and hasattr(task, "cancel"):
custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/__i.reason: hass.async_create_task (homeassistant.core.HomeAssistant.async_create_task) returns an asyncio.Task, which always carries cancel; the OR form differs only for a non-None object without a cancel attribute, which that return cannot be -- round-5 D3-07.

custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/opt.reason: void mutant, round-6 D3-02 (#1385): the guard fences only a `_LOGGER.debug(...)` call; the function's `return changed` sits OUTSIDE the if, so `if changed:` -> `if True:` differs only in whether a debug line logs, which no check reads. No honest test should fail on this mutant.

reason: max_survivor_fraction was OPEN at 1.0 and therefore unsatisfiable: rate = survivors/evaluated is a fraction in [0,1], so `if rate > 1.0` can never fire and a run in which every mutant survives printed PASSED. The caps are now recorded at the last measured rates -- 0.2 (2 survivors of 10) and 0.3 (12 of 40) -- so they are saturable. The ratchet is the exact-count `unpinned_sites`: 3791 candidate sites enumerated deterministically over all 64 production modules, of which 3788 carry no recorded disposition (3 are triaged equivalent: pump_mode.py:242, __init__.py:340, optimizer.py:3546). The recorded survivors in last_measured still need disposition -- the nightly burn-in kills or triages them in cost order -- and each disposition must name the mechanism; the ratchet refuses any NEW site without one. Do not raise `unpinned_sites` by hand: the exact count is re-derived every run by tests/mutation_table.py, which refuses growth and only records down via --record.
